lines: I do not have a trade for that sort of night. I survived it anyway.
I found a corner, then a path, then home. That's more plan than I started with.
I made it back without a trade, a plan, or much dignity. Still counts.
I learned that I am very motivated by closed doors and warm lights.
Home looked like the best job I could possibly have.
I survived by following people who seemed less confused than I was.
I reached the village and decided that was enough achievement for the day.
I have no title for what I did. I lived through it.
When danger came close, nobody had time to sound brave first.
You learn a lot about a village when everyone hears the bell at once.
